title: Constructing a Chinese Medical Conversation Corpus Annotated with Conversational Structures and Actions
summary: AMed provides a Chinese medical conversation corpus with annotations of conversational structures and actions, supporting research into how patients and clinicians organize information during pediatric consultations.
authors: Nan Wang, Yan Song, Fei Xia

title: Coding Structures and Actions with the COSTA Scheme in Medical Conversations
summary: COSTA defines a layered scheme for coding structures and actions in medical conversations, providing a framework for examining the organization of naturally occurring pediatric consultations in Chinese.
authors: Nan Wang, Yan Song, Fei Xia

title: Domain Adaptation for Disease Phrase Matching with Adversarial Networks
summary: This approach uses adversarial domain adaptation to match disease phrases with equivalent meanings, studying how information can transfer between medical subdomains when annotated training examples are limited.
authors: Miaofeng Liu, Jialong Han, Haisong Zhang, Yan Song

title: ChiMed: A Chinese Medical Corpus for Question Answering
summary: ChiMed organizes Chinese medical questions and physician answers into a research corpus, with answer relevance and adoption prediction tasks for studying medical question answering and response selection.
authors: Yuanhe Tian, Weicheng Ma, Fei Xia, Yan Song

title: WTMED at MEDIQA 2019: A Hybrid Approach to Biomedical Natural Language Inference
summary: WTMED combines pretrained language representations with syntactic and biomedical features, using model ensembles and conflict resolution to determine inference relationships between pairs of biomedical sentences in benchmark tasks.
authors: Zhaofeng Wu, Yan Song, Sicong Huang, Yuanhe Tian, Fei Xia

title: Knowledge-aware Pronoun Coreference Resolution
summary: A knowledge attention mechanism selects external information for pronoun coreference resolution, studying how knowledge supports linking pronouns to their referents in general text and medical narrative benchmarks.
authors: Hongming Zhang, Yan Song, Yangqiu Song, Dong Yu

title: Studying Challenges in Medical Conversation with Structured Annotation
summary: Structured annotations of Chinese pediatric consultations support an analysis of conversation openings, communication problems, and closing sequences, examining how conversational organization shapes the exchange of medical information.
authors: Nan Wang, Yan Song, Fei Xia

title: Summarizing Medical Conversations via Identifying Important Utterances
summary: A hierarchical approach identifies important utterances in medical conversations and uses their representations to organize summaries around patient problems and physician responses, connecting dialogue structure with summary content.
authors: Yan Song, Yuanhe Tian, Nan Wang, Fei Xia

title: Improving biomedical named entity recognition with syntactic information
summary: BioKMNER uses key-value memory networks to select syntactic information for biomedical named entity recognition, combining contextual features with linguistic structure to identify diseases, chemicals, genes, and species.
authors: Yuanhe Tian, Wang Shen, Yan Song, Fei Xia, Min He, Kenli Li

title: Generating Radiology Reports via Memory-driven Transformer
summary: R2Gen combines a relational memory with memory-driven conditional layer normalization, incorporating information accumulated during generation into a Transformer decoder to produce extended radiology reports from chest images.
authors: Zhihong Chen, Yan Song, Tsung-Hui Chang, Xiang Wan

title: Exploring Word Segmentation and Medical Concept Recognition for Chinese Medical Texts
summary: ACEMR provides Chinese electronic medical records annotated for word segmentation and medical concept recognition, supporting comparisons of language processing models on tasks requiring word boundaries and domain terminology.
authors: Yang Liu, Yuanhe Tian, Tsung-Hui Chang, Song Wu, Xiang Wan, Yan Song

title: Cross-modal Memory Networks for Radiology Report Generation
summary: Shared cross-modal memory captures correspondences between visual features and report text, allowing image and language representations to interact through stored patterns during the generation of radiology reports.
authors: Zhihong Chen, Yaling Shen, Yan Song, Xiang Wan

title: Word Graph Guided Summarization for Radiology Findings
summary: WGSum builds word graphs from important terms and their relationships in radiology findings, using graph representations to guide the generation of impression summaries that condense report content.
authors: Jinpeng Hu, Jianling Li, Zhihong Chen, Yaling Shen, Yan Song, Xiang Wan, Tsung-Hui Chang

title: ChiMST: A Chinese Medical Corpus for Word Segmentation and Medical Term Recognition
summary: ChiMST annotates word boundaries and fine-grained medical terms in Chinese medical question answering text, providing a shared resource for studying segmentation and terminology recognition within the same corpus.
authors: Yuanhe Tian, Han Qin, Fei Xia, Yan Song

title: Reinforced Cross-modal Alignment for Radiology Report Generation
summary: R2GenRL uses reinforcement learning to optimize image-text alignment within cross-modal memory, connecting report generation signals with the alignment process when learning how visual evidence corresponds to report content.
authors: Han Qin, Yan Song

title: A Systematic Review of Deep Learning-based Research on Radiology Report Generation
summary: This systematic review organizes deep learning research on radiology report generation by visual, textual, and cross-modal methods, bringing together datasets, evaluation measures, and challenges across the research area.
authors: Chang Liu, Yuanhe Tian, Yan Song

title: Bootstrapping Large Language Models for Radiology Report Generation
summary: R2-LLM adapts a general language model to radiology report generation through in-domain instance induction and coarse-to-fine decoding, connecting retrieved examples with successive stages of report refinement.
authors: Chang Liu, Yuanhe Tian, Weidong Chen, Yan Song, Yongdong Zhang

title: Improving Radiology Report Generation with D²-Net: When Diffusion Meets Discriminator
summary: D²-Net combines diffusion-based generation with a discriminative mechanism for radiology reporting, examining how these complementary modeling components can guide the production of textual descriptions from medical image inputs.
authors: Yuda Jin, Weidong Chen, Yuanhe Tian, Yan Song, Chenggang Yan, Zhendong Mao

title: Diffusion Networks with Task-Specific Noise Control for Radiology Report Generation
summary: ControlDiff uses task-specific visual and textual information to construct noise for diffusion networks, studying how iterative denoising can organize global and local content when generating radiology reports.
authors: Yuanhe Tian, Fei Xia, Yan Song

title: ChiMed-GPT: A Chinese Medical Large Language Model with Full Training Regime and Better Alignment to Human Preferences
summary: ChiMed-GPT combines continued pretraining, supervised instruction tuning, and preference alignment for Chinese medical language modeling, with evaluations spanning information extraction, question answering, and medical dialogue generation.
authors: Yuanhe Tian, Ruyi Gan, Yan Song, Jiaxing Zhang, Yongdong Zhang

title: medIKAL: Integrating Knowledge Graphs as Assistants of LLMs for Enhanced Clinical Diagnosis on EMRs
summary: medIKAL combines language model reasoning with knowledge graph search over electronic medical records, using candidate disease localization and path ranking to structure information for research on diagnosis tasks.
authors: Mingyi Jia, Junwen Duan, Yan Song, Jianxin Wang

title: ICA-RAG: Information Completeness Guided Adaptive Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Disease Diagnosis
summary: ICA-RAG estimates information completeness in medical records to decide when retrieval is needed, then filters retrieved knowledge to support adaptive retrieval-augmented generation for disease diagnosis research.
authors: Jiawei He, Mingyi Jia, Zhihao Jia, Junwen Duan, Yan Song, Jianxin Wang

title: ChiMed 2.0: Advancing Chinese Medical Dataset in Facilitating Large Language Modeling
summary: ChiMed 2.0 organizes traditional Chinese and modern medical texts into pretraining documents, supervised question-answer pairs, and preference data, supporting different stages of training Chinese medical language models.
authors: Yuanhe Tian, Junjie Liu, Zhizhou Kou, Yuxiang Li, Yan Song

title: Cross-modal Feature Graph Modeling for Computed Tomography Visual Question Answering
summary: This approach represents CT slices and question tokens as a cross-modal graph, combining information about slice continuity and question content to generate answers to questions about volumetric images.
authors: Yuanhe Tian, Chen Su, Junwen Duan, Yan Song

title: Feature Decomposition via Shared Low-Rank Matrix Recovery for CT Report Generation
summary: Shared low-rank matrix recovery separates common background information from distinct CT features, combining continuous slice encoding with visual representations to condition language models for volumetric report generation.
authors: Yuanhe Tian, Yan Song
venue: IEEE Transactions on Medical Imaging 45(4), 1501–1512 · online 2025

title: Extractive Radiology Reporting With Memory-Based Cross-Modal Representations
summary: Memory-based cross-modal representations support an extractive approach to radiology reporting, selecting and organizing report content through learned image-text associations rather than relying exclusively on generating each successive token.
authors: Yuanhe Tian, Zexuan Yan, Nenan Lyu, Yan Song
venue: IEEE Transactions on Medical Imaging 45(4), 1686–1697 · online 2025

title: LEAD: Layer-wise Expert-aligned Decoding for Faithful Radiology Report Generation
summary: LEAD incorporates multiple expert pathology features across decoder layers, studying how layer-wise expert alignment can connect image evidence with the text produced during radiology report generation by multimodal models.
authors: Ruixiao Yang, Yuanhe Tian, Xu Yang, Huiqi Li, Yan Song

title: SliceWorld: A Predictive and Controllable World-State Model for CT Report Generation
summary: SliceWorld models anatomical, lesion, and uncertainty states across CT slice sequences, connecting future feature prediction and latent interventions with language generation to study predictive and controllable CT reporting.
authors: Yuanhe Tian, Yan Song

title: WPG-MoE: Weak-Prior-Guided Dense Mixture-of-Experts for User-Level Social Media Depression Detection
summary: WPG-MoE uses weak semantic priors to guide a dense mixture of experts, modeling differences in how social media users express evidence associated with depression risk across their posts.
authors: Xian Li, Yuanhe Tian, Yang Yang, Guoqing Wang, Yan Song

title: On-demand instance-wise adaptation of large language models for radiology report generation
summary: On-demand instance-wise adaptation selects relevant training examples for each test image and adapts a language model at inference time, using pathology matching and contrasting instances to guide radiology reporting.
authors: Yan Song, Yuanhe Tian, Yongdong Zhang

title: Recurrent Visual Feature Extraction and Stereo Attentions for CT Report Generation
summary: Recurrent visual encoding tracks ordered CT slices while stereo attention combines hierarchical visual features, providing a language model with representations for generating reports from three-dimensional CT examinations.
authors: Yuanhe Tian, Lei Mao, Yan Song

title: Semantic Memory Guided Diffusion Networks for Image-to-Long Text Generation
summary: SeMDiff predicts semantic concepts and refines their representations through conditional memory to guide diffusion-based long text generation, including experiments on describing medical images alongside general image description tasks.
